hooks.command: jq -c '(.tool_input.command // "") as $c | if ($c | test("deploy-prod")) then (if ($c | gsub("^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$"; "")) == "make deploy-prod" then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:"make deploy-prod: operator one-time go-ahead required (Deployment Law)"}} else {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"deploy-prod embedded in a larger command - hard-blocked (Deployment Law; injection incident 2026-07-27)"}} end) else empty end'

jq -c '(.tool_input.command // "") as $c | if ($c | test("push[[:space:]].*--delete|--delete-branch|push[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+[[:space:]]+:[^[:space:]]|DELETE.+refs/heads|refs/heads.+DELETE|branch[[:space:]]+(-[dD]([[:space:]]|$)|--delete)|worktree[[:space:]]+(remove|prune)")) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:"branch/worktree deletion requires the operator hard yes (standing rule: only on operator command; remote branches never)"}} else empty end'
